task_definition.task_name: Synthetic Seismograms Retrieve via Syngine Service

task_description.overview: Download high-frequency global synthetic seismograms for specified source-receiver combinations using IRIS Syngine.
steps: Specify source parameters (latitude, longitude, depth, magnitude) and receiver coordinates.
Choose the Earth model or synthetics engine.
Request synthetic waveform data for desired channels and time window.
Save the synthetic waveforms in MiniSEED or SAC format.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using the ObsPy Syngine client, download synthetic seismograms for network={network}, station={station}, eventid={eventid}. Use model={model}. Figure the synthetic waveform. Save the synthetic waveforms to {synthetic_mseed_file} and the synthetic waveform figure to {synthetic_waveform_figure}.
